name: Sphere
description: The first clip wraps onto a shaded ball that shrinks and rolls away, revealing the second under its shadow. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the ball rolls (x right, y up)

params.name: size
params.description: Radius of the wrapped ball, relative to the shorter side

params.name: shading
params.description: Strength of the light on the ball
